items.distractor_fact: ከዚህ ጣቢያ በአጠገብ በሚገኘው ቀጣዩ መንደር ውስጥ ያለው መለኪያ በዚያው ጠዋት {D}°ሴ አስመዘገበ።
items.gloss_en: The gauge in the next village near this station recorded {D}°C that same morning. (Invariant: the unit symbol °C is written right after the numeral like an abbreviation and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: a different weather gauge, in a neighboring village, not this story's station

items.gloss_en: That same day, a different company's share price closed at {D} birr. (Invariant: the count noun 'ብር' follows the bare numeral and never inflects, for any integer.)
